# Brain-gated burn-in retries once until 2026-10-25, naming every retried test

## Context

The steward's call on #19657 ([comment](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/issues/19657)) accepted one retry as a bridge while the intermittent set is diagnosed ([analysis](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/issues/19657#issuecomment-6130780202)), with these bounds:
- only the Brain-gated burn-in tier retries; the engine tier and every PR-blocking job keep `retries: 0`;
- the receipt names every test that needed the retry, with its first-attempt error;
- a test red on both attempts is red;
- the bridge ends at the class repair, and no later than 2026-10-25 (the v13.3 date).

## The Problem

At the current rates, a fully green burn-in run has a probability of about 0.2%, so #19657's streak cannot start while the intermittent set is being diagnosed. A plain retry would hide exactly what the burn-in exists to measure. A Playwright retry runs in a fresh worker, so a cross-file leak always heals on it and is labelled `flaky`. That makes `flaky` a positive detection, never an all-clear.

## The Architectural Reality

- `test-e2e-brain.yml` runs the tier, and `buildScripts/util/e2eCiSelection.mjs` owns its selection and receipt (after #19676).
- Playwright's JSON report marks a test `flaky` when an attempt failed and a later one passed. `stats.flaky` counts them, and each test's `results[0]` carries the first attempt's error.

## The Fix

- A declared bridge in `e2eCiSelection.mjs`: one retry until 2026-10-25, with its reason and tracker. The workflow reads the count from it, so the bridge ends on the date without anyone editing it, the same way quarantines age.
- Every receipt prints the bridge's state and names each retried test with its first-attempt error.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] The burn-in passes `--retries=1` until 2026-10-25 and `--retries=0` afterwards, read from the one declaration. No other job changes.
- [ ] Every receipt names each `flaky` test with its first-attempt error and states the bridge and its end date. A test red on every attempt stays a failure.
- [ ] Unit arms cover the date boundary and the receipt's flaky naming.

## Out of Scope

Diagnosing the intermittent set (#19657), and any retry in the engine tier or a PR-blocking job.
